question: Indicate which of the drugs listed below and used in the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension is NOT an analogue of prostacyclin:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Iloprost is a synthetic analogue of prostacyclin -> it mimics the effects of prostacyclin in the body -> not the answer -> 90%
CHAIN: Treprostinil is also a synthetic analogue of prostacyclin -> it functions similarly to prostacyclin -> not the answer -> 90%
CHAIN: Epoprostenol is a natural form of prostacyclin -> it directly acts as prostacyclin in the body -> not the answer -> 90%
CHAIN: Riociguat is a soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator -> it does not mimic prostacyclin -> this is the drug that is NOT an analogue of prostacyclin -> 95%
analysis: Riociguat is a soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator and does not act as a prostacyclin analogue, unlike Iloprost, Treprostinil, and Epoprostenol, which are all prostacyclin analogues used in the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension.
